This can make it more difficult to consider alternative moral frameworks or challenge your own assumptions. On one hand, being part of a supportive community can provide a sense of guidance and direction. By being aware of these factors and actively seeking out diverse perspectives, you can cultivate a more well-rounded and empathetic understanding of right and wrong, while still maintaining your connection to your religious community.
